concerns.text: FR-004 specifies a *single* subject‑level variability predictor, but T003 implements ten PCA components (PCA_Component_1 … PCA_Component_10) and stores them all. This deviates from the spec’s requirement and leaves the primary predictor undefined.

SC-001 (proportion of subjects successfully processed) is listed in the spec but no task computes, records, or verifies this metric. There is no verification step that reports the proportion of retained subjects versus total downloaded subjects.
